title: Text: DET Jeff Wetherby ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: That’s not true. Various guys have been traded and are doing very well,,,Suarez, Adames, Hernan Perez, Avisail Garcia. 2018 class we had Jose De La Cruz and Afonso Reyes and Lazaro Benitez all hit .30
searchText: that’s not true. various guys have been traded and are doing very well,,,suarez, adames, hernan perez, avisail garcia. 2018 class we had jose de la cruz and afonso reyes and lazaro benitez all hit .300. please, look up their numbers. also, we are not in the rankings because we keep shit quiet. whoever that scout was that you spoke with is full of shit. and, we have damned near just about as much money as everyone else (since i got here) and we’re spending it. there coming! del la cruz was in the top three or five of all categories.  det jeff wetherby
